task.title: Reviewing the last day worked (LDW) and last day paid (LDP)

step.cmd: Determine if the LDW on the application and the LDP on the last ROE are within 14 days of each other (LDW plus or minus 13 days):

ul.li: If the LDW and LDP are within 14 days of each other, accept the result and go to Determining if the client received QPIP benefits . Determining if the client received QPIP benefits

If the LDW and LDP are not within 14 days of each other, determine if the LDW is before or after the LDP (e.g. LDW is May 1 and LDP is May 30):
If the LDW is after the LDP, go to step 2.
If the LDW is before the LDP, go to step 6.

step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to determine why the LDW on the application is more than 14 days after the LDP on the last ROE.
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 4.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Calculation .
Comments: Type “Last day worked versus last day paid.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if the client has provided a new LDW which is within 14 days (plus or minus) of the LDP on the ROE:

ul.li: If the client has not provided a new LDW which is within 14 days (plus or minus) of the LDP on the ROE, go to step 7.
If the client has provided a new LDW which is within 14 days (plus or minus) of the LDP on the ROE, refer to Modifying the last day worked in SSO . Modifying the last day worked in SSO

step.cmd: Determine if the ROE confirms that the client has received insurable earnings (e.g. PSL, salary continuance, scheduled paid vacation days, or scheduled insurable days off) after ceasing work:

ul.li: If the ROE confirms that the client has received insurable earnings after the LDW, go to Determining if the client received QPIP benefits . Determining if the client received QPIP benefits
If the ROE does not confirm that the client has received insurable earnings after the LDW, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Fact-find with the employer to determine why the LDW and the LDP dates differ by more than 14 days. If applicable, provide the information received from the client.
Determine if the employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the employer was not contacted, go to step 9.
If the employer was contacted, go to step 18.

step.cmd: In ACS, send a registered copy of the Z-02-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:
In NWS, move the calculation WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Z-02-00-00 letter sent.”
Bring forward date: Enter the date the letter is sent + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the calculation WI moves to the current workload, determine if the information is now on file:

ul.li: If no, go to step 12.
If yes, go to step 18.

step.cmd: Refer the file to Integrity for employer non-compliance.
Determine if there has been an attempt to contact the client:

ul.li: If contact has not been attempted, fact-find with the client to determine why the LDW and the LDP dates differ by more than 14 days. Go to step 14. fact-find
If contact has been attempted and the client responded, go to step 16.

If contact has been attempted and the client did not respond, on the calculation worksheet, note that a 15 - Claim procedure (D15) disentitlement is required if the client qualifies and go to step 18.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 15.
If the client was not contacted, on the calculation worksheet, note that a (D15) disentitlement is required if the client qualifies for benefits. Go to step 17.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Calculation .
Comments: Type “Last day worked versus last day paid.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if the client has confirmed the LDW provided on the application:

ul.li: If the client provides a new LDW which is within 14 days (plus or minus) of the LDP on the ROE, refer to Modifying the last day worked in SSO . Modifying the last day worked in SSO
If no information has been provided, go to step 17.

If the client has confirmed the LDW on the application is correct, determine if the LDW is before or after the LDP on the ROE:
If the LDW is after the LDP, obtain the information from the client to enter an interim ROE . enter an interim ROE
If the LDW is before the LDP, accept the ROE as provided and advise the client that the claim will be reviewed when information is received from the employer.
Go to step 17.

step.cmd: Accept the calculation as displayed and go to Determining if the client received QPIP benefits .
In RCM, make any required changes to the ROE according to the information obtained during fact-finding.

ul.li: If the employer was contacted, in the Additional information field , document the information obtained.

Select Validate and determine if an error is displayed:
If no error is displayed, select Submit and go to step 19.
If an error is displayed, refer to Correcting an ROE and go to step 19. Correcting an ROE

step.cmd: Review the new or amended information to determine if an I of E has occurred:

ul.li: If an I of E has occurred, go to step 9 of Calculating a claim in SSO . Calculating a claim in SSO
If an I of E has not occurred, refer to Indicating in SSO that there is no interruption of earnings . Indicating in SSO that there is no interruption of earnings
